result.instructions: Tools for Veeqo, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Veeqo data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run veeqo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run veeqo_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run veeqo_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. veeqo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: veeqo_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: The Veeqo company this API key belongs to: id, name, product (e.g. veeqo-shipping), paying/trial state, address and company settings (currency, weight/dimension units, timezone). The employee list and billing internals are not returned. GET /current_company.

tools.name: veeqo_list_stores
tools.title: List stores (sales channels)
tools.description: List the sales channels (stores) connected to Veeqo — Amazon, eBay, Shopify, POS, etc. — with id, name, type and state. Use the ids to filter orders by store. Marketplace credentials and integration settings are never returned. GET /channels.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: veeqo_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses with address, phone and dispatch cut-off times. Use the ids for stock levels and warehouse filters. GET /warehouses.

external_id.description: Only the warehouse with this external id.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: veeqo_get_warehouse
tools.title: Get warehouse
tools.description: One warehouse by id. GET /warehouses/{id}.

tools.name: veeqo_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List or search orders, newest first, with line items, customer, delivery address, store, allocations and shipments (tracking numbers). Filter by status, store, tag, free text, created/due date or update time. GET /orders.

query.description: Free-text search (order number, customer name, email, SKU...).

channel_ids.description: Only orders from these store (channel) ids — see veeqo_list_stores.

tag.description: Only orders carrying the tag with this exact name.

allocated_at_warehouse_id.description: Only orders allocated at this warehouse id.

created_after.description: Only orders created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_before.description: Only orders created on or before this date, whole day included (yyyy-mm-dd).

due_after.description: Only orders due on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

due_before.description: Only orders due on or before this date, whole day included (yyyy-mm-dd).

updated_since.description: Only orders updated at or after this ISO 8601 date-time with timezone (sent in UTC).

since_id.description: Only orders with an id greater than this.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: veeqo_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by id: status, totals, line items (sellable ids, SKUs, quantities), customer and delivery address, store, notes, tags, allocations and shipments with tracking numbers. GET /orders/{id}.

order_id.description: Veeqo order id (not the store's order number — find it with veeqo_list_orders query).

tools.name: veeqo_get_order_returns
tools.title: Get order returns
tools.description: Returns (RMAs) recorded on an order for one of its sellables: return number, status, reason, returned line items and received quantities. Veeqo's reference requires the sellable id (an order line item's sellable.id). GET /orders/{id}/returns?sellable_id=.

sellable_id.description: Sellable (variant) id of the returned item — veeqo_get_order → line_items[].sellable.id.

tools.name: veeqo_get_shipment_tracking
tools.title: Get shipment tracking
tools.description: Tracking events (timestamp, status, description, location) for a shipment. Available when the label was bought in Veeqo. The shipment id is in an order's allocations[].shipment. GET /shipping/tracking_events/{shipment_id}.

tools.name: veeqo_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List or search products with their sellables (variants): SKU, UPC, price, cost, and per-warehouse stock entries (physical, allocated, available). GET /products.

query.description: Search by product name or SKU.

warehouse_id.description: Only products with stock in this warehouse.

created_since.description: Only products created at or after this ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

updated_since.description: Only products updated at or after this ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

since_id.description: Only products with an id greater than this.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: veeqo_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by id with all sellables (variants), prices, weights, customs data and stock entries per warehouse. GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: veeqo_get_stock_entry
tools.title: Get stock level
tools.description: Stock of one sellable (variant) in one warehouse: physical, allocated, available, incoming (purchase orders) and in-transit levels, bin location and the low-stock flag. GET /sellables/{sellable_id}/warehouses/{warehouse_id}/stock_entry.

sellable_id.description: Sellable (variant) id — product.sellables[].id, not the product id.

tools.name: veeqo_set_stock_level
tools.title: Set stock level
tools.description: WRITE: set the physical stock level of ONE sellable in ONE warehouse (a stock count correction), optionally its bin location. This overwrites the current on-hand quantity, and Veeqo may push the new available stock to the connected sales channels. The entry's infinite-stock setting is read first and kept as it is (this tool never changes it). Veeqo marks this endpoint 'Paid plan only'. GET then PUT /sellables/{sellable_id}/warehouses/{warehouse_id}/stock_entry.

location.description: Bin/shelf location in the warehouse, e.g. 'Shelf 2B'.

tools.name: veeqo_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers with email, phone, billing address and shipping addresses. GET /customers.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. an email address or name.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: veeqo_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by id with billing and shipping addresses and notes. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: veeqo_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with address, sales/accounting contacts, currency, credit limit and open/completed purchase-order counts (bank details are not returned). Paid Veeqo plans only. GET /suppliers.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: veeqo_get_supplier
tools.title: Get supplier
tools.description: One supplier by id (bank details are not returned). Paid Veeqo plans only. GET /suppliers/{id}.

tools.name: veeqo_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List or search purchase orders with supplier, destination warehouse and line items (ordered/received quantities, cost). Search-index backed, so a just-changed PO may be stale here — confirm with veeqo_get_purchase_order. Paid Veeqo plans only. GET /purchase_orders.

query.description: Search supplier name/post code, PO number, reference, SKU, UPC or item title.

state.description: Lifecycle state (draft/active/completed) or a received-status filter (not_received, partially_received, fully_received, past_due, all). Default: all states including drafts.

destination_warehouse_id.description: Only POs delivering to this warehouse.

sellable_id.description: Only active POs containing this sellable (variant) id.

created_after.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_before.description: Created on or before this date, whole day included (yyyy-mm-dd).

updated_since.description: Updated at or after this ISO 8601 date-time with timezone.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: veeqo_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get purchase order
tools.description: One purchase order by id with supplier, destination warehouse and every line item. Paid Veeqo plans only. GET /purchase_orders/{id}.

tools.name: veeqo_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: All tags in the account (id, name, colour, how many records use it). Use the ids with veeqo_tag_orders. GET /tags.

tools.name: veeqo_list_delivery_methods
tools.title: List delivery methods
tools.description: List the delivery methods orders can use (id, name, cost). GET /delivery_methods.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: veeqo_add_order_note
tools.title: Add order note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal (employee) note to an order, e.g. 'Customer asked for gift wrap'. It is visible to your Veeqo team on the order; it is not emailed to the customer. Notes cannot be deleted through the API. POST /orders/{order_id}/notes.

tools.name: veeqo_tag_orders
tools.title: Tag orders
tools.description: WRITE: apply existing tags (ids from veeqo_list_tags) to up to 50 orders. Tags can drive Veeqo automation rules and filters. Tagging an order that already has the tag changes nothing. POST /bulk_tagging.
